CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_forward BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_trails
WHEN NEW.key_fingerprint IS NOT OLD.key_fingerprint
  OR NEW.robot_index IS NOT OLD.robot_index
  OR NEW.network IS NOT OLD.network
  OR NEW.coordinator_alias IS NOT OLD.coordinator_alias
  OR NEW.order_id IS NOT OLD.order_id
  OR NEW.role IS NOT OLD.role
  OR NEW.version < OLD.version
  OR NEW.read_at < OLD.read_at
  OR NEW.breached < OLD.breached
  OR NEW.history_unknown IS NOT OLD.history_unknown
  OR (OLD.bond_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bond_hash IS NOT OLD.bond_hash)
  OR (OLD.escrow_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.escrow_hash IS NOT OLD.escrow_hash)
  OR (OLD.bond_step_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.bond_step_seen_at IS NULL OR NEW.bond_step_seen_at < OLD.bond_step_seen_at))
  OR (OLD.bond_step_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bond_step_deadline IS NULL)
  OR (OLD.position IN ('succeeded', 'makerLostDispute', 'takerLostDispute', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'publicAgain', 'notAvailable') AND NEW.position IS NOT OLD.position)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a trail only moves forward');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trades_set_once BEFORE UPDATE ON trades
WHEN OLD.closed_at IS NOT NULL
  OR (OLD.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.confirmed_at IS NOT OLD.confirmed_at)
  OR NEW.network IS NOT OLD.network
  OR NEW.key_fingerprint IS NOT OLD.key_fingerprint
  OR NEW.robot_index IS NOT OLD.robot_index
  OR NEW.coordinator_alias IS NOT OLD.coordinator_alias
  OR NEW.coordinator_onion IS NOT OLD.coordinator_onion
  OR NEW.order_id IS NOT OLD.order_id
  OR NEW.role IS NOT OLD.role
  OR NEW.origin IS NOT OLD.origin
  OR NEW.taken_at IS NOT OLD.taken_at
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a trade record only gains its times');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "robot_bindings" ("network" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "robot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "coordinator_alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "coordinator_onion" TEXT NOT NULL, "coordinator_node_keys" TEXT NOT NULL, "coordinator_nostr_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "bound_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generated' CHECK (provenance IN ('generated', 'acknowledged')), PRIMARY KEY ("key_fingerprint", "robot_index"), CHECK (network IN ('mainnet', 'testnet')), CHECK (length(key_fingerprint) = 64), CHECK (robot_index BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647), CHECK (length(coordinator_alias) > 0), CHECK (length(coordinator_onion) > 0), CHECK (length(coordinator_nostr_key) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trades" ("network" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "robot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "coordinator_alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "coordinator_onion" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_at" INTEGER NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key_fingerprint", "robot_index"), CHECK (network IN ('mainnet', 'testnet')), CHECK (length(key_fingerprint) = 64 AND key_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CHECK (robot_index BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647), CHECK (length(coordinator_alias) > 0), CHECK (length(coordinator_onion) > 0), CHECK (order_id > 0), CHECK (role IN ('buyer', 'seller')), CHECK (origin IN ('takenHere', 'recovered')), CHECK (origin = 'takenHere' OR confirmed_at IS NOT NULL), CHECK (taken_at BETWEEN 0 AND 8640000000000000), CHECK (confirmed_at IS NULL OR confirmed_at BETWEEN 0 AND 8640000000000000), CHECK (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at BETWEEN 0 AND 8640000000000000), FOREIGN KEY (key_fingerprint, robot_index, network) REFERENCES robot_bindings (key_fingerprint, robot_index, network));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trade_terms" ("key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "robot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "network" TEXT NOT NULL, "coordinator_alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "is_range" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_range" IN (0, 1)), "premium_percent" REAL NOT NULL, "explicit_satoshis" INTEGER NULL, "bond_size_percent" REAL NOT NULL, "escrow_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "book_price" REAL NOT NULL, "taker_fee" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key_fingerprint", "robot_index"), CHECK (length(key_fingerprint) = 64 AND key_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CHECK (robot_index BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647), CHECK (version >= 1), CHECK (network IN ('mainnet', 'testnet')), CHECK (length(coordinator_alias) > 0), CHECK (order_id BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740992), CHECK (role IN ('buyer', 'seller')), CHECK ((order_type = 1 AND role = 'buyer') OR (order_type = 0 AND role = 'seller')), CHECK (currency_id > 0), CHECK (typeof(amount) = 'real' AND amount > 0 AND amount < 1000000000000000), CHECK (typeof(premium_percent) = 'real' AND premium_percent >= -100 AND premium_percent < 1000000000000000), CHECK (explicit_satoshis IS NULL OR explicit_satoshis BETWEEN 1 AND 2100000000000000), CHECK (typeof(bond_size_percent) = 'real' AND bond_size_percent BETWEEN 2 AND 15), CHECK (escrow_seconds BETWEEN 1800 AND 36000), CHECK (typeof(book_price) = 'real' AND book_price > 0 AND book_price < 1000000000000000), CHECK (typeof(taker_fee) = 'real' AND taker_fee BETWEEN 0 AND 0.01), FOREIGN KEY (key_fingerprint, robot_index) REFERENCES trades (key_fingerprint, robot_index));
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_terms_never_deleted BEFORE DELETE ON trade_terms BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'the terms of a trade are kept');END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_terms_set_once BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_terms BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'the terms of a trade are set once');END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_terms_inserted_once BEFORE INSERT ON trade_terms WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade_terms WHERE key_fingerprint = NEW.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = NEW.robot_index) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (IGNORE);END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_terms_of_their_trade BEFORE INSERT ON trade_terms WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trades WHERE key_fingerprint = NEW.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = NEW.robot_index AND network = NEW.network AND coordinator_alias = NEW.coordinator_alias AND order_id = NEW.order_id AND role = NEW.role AND closed_at IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'terms of no open trade');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trade_trails" ("key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "robot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "network" TEXT NOT NULL, "coordinator_alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" TEXT NOT NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bond_hash" TEXT NULL, "escrow_hash" TEXT NULL, "deadline" INTEGER NULL, "bond_step_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "bond_step_deadline" INTEGER NULL, "breached" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("breached" IN (0, 1)), "history_unknown" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("history_unknown" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("key_fingerprint", "robot_index"), CHECK (length(key_fingerprint) = 64 AND key_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CHECK (robot_index BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647), CHECK (version >= 1), CHECK (network IN ('mainnet', 'testnet')), CHECK (length(coordinator_alias) > 0), CHECK (order_id BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740992), CHECK (role IN ('buyer', 'seller')), CHECK (position IN ('start', 'bondStep', 'preTakeUnavailable', 'waitingForBoth', 'waitingForEscrow', 'waitingForPayout', 'chatting', 'fiatSent', 'inDispute', 'sendingSats', 'succeeded', 'routingFailed', 'waitingDisputeResolution', 'makerLostDispute', 'takerLostDispute', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'publicAgain', 'notAvailable')), CHECK (read_at BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799999999), CHECK (deadline IS NULL OR deadline BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799999999), CHECK (bond_step_seen_at IS NULL OR bond_step_seen_at BETWEEN 0 AND read_at), CHECK (bond_step_deadline IS NULL OR bond_step_deadline BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799999999), CHECK (bond_hash IS NULL OR (length(bond_hash) = 64 AND bond_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), CHECK (escrow_hash IS NULL OR (length(escrow_hash) = 64 AND escrow_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), FOREIGN KEY (key_fingerprint, robot_index) REFERENCES trades (key_fingerprint, robot_index));
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_never_deleted BEFORE DELETE ON trade_trails BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'the trail of a trade is kept');END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_inserted_once BEFORE INSERT ON trade_trails WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade_trails WHERE key_fingerprint = NEW.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = NEW.robot_index) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (IGNORE);END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_of_their_trade BEFORE INSERT ON trade_trails WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trades JOIN trade_terms ON trade_terms.key_fingerprint = trades.key_fingerprint AND trade_terms.robot_index = trades.robot_index WHERE trades.key_fingerprint = NEW.key_fingerprint AND trades.robot_index = NEW.robot_index AND trades.network = NEW.network AND trades.coordinator_alias = NEW.coordinator_alias AND trades.order_id = NEW.order_id AND trades.role = NEW.role AND trades.closed_at IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a trail of no open trade');END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_closed BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_trails WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trades WHERE key_fingerprint = OLD.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = OLD.robot_index AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (IGNORE);END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_forward BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_trails WHEN NEW.key_fingerprint IS NOT OLD.key_fingerprint OR NEW.robot_index IS NOT OLD.robot_index OR NEW.network IS NOT OLD.network OR NEW.coordinator_alias IS NOT OLD.coordinator_alias OR NEW.order_id IS NOT OLD.order_id OR NEW.role IS NOT OLD.role OR NEW.version < OLD.version OR NEW.read_at < OLD.read_at OR NEW.breached < OLD.breached OR NEW.history_unknown IS NOT OLD.history_unknown OR(OLD.bond_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bond_hash IS NOT OLD.bond_hash)OR(OLD.escrow_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.escrow_hash IS NOT OLD.escrow_hash)OR(OLD.bond_step_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND(NEW.bond_step_seen_at IS NULL OR NEW.bond_step_seen_at < OLD.bond_step_seen_at))OR(OLD.bond_step_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bond_step_deadline IS NULL)OR(OLD.position IN ('succeeded', 'makerLostDispute', 'takerLostDispute', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'publicAgain', 'notAvailable') AND NEW.position IS NOT OLD.position)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a trail only moves forward');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "garage_key_histories" ("network" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("network", "key_fingerprint"), CHECK (network IN ('mainnet', 'testnet')), CHECK (length(key_fingerprint) = 64), CHECK (origin IN ('generated', 'imported', 'acknowledged')));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS robot_bindings_network ON robot_bindings (key_fingerprint, robot_index, network)
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trades_never_deleted BEFORE DELETE ON trades BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a trade record is kept');END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trades_set_once BEFORE UPDATE ON trades WHEN OLD.closed_at IS NOT NULL OR(OLD.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.confirmed_at IS NOT OLD.confirmed_at)OR NEW.network IS NOT OLD.network OR NEW.key_fingerprint IS NOT OLD.key_fingerprint OR NEW.robot_index IS NOT OLD.robot_index OR NEW.coordinator_alias IS NOT OLD.coordinator_alias OR NEW.coordinator_onion IS NOT OLD.coordinator_onion OR NEW.order_id IS NOT OLD.order_id OR NEW.role IS NOT OLD.role OR NEW.origin IS NOT OLD.origin OR NEW.taken_at IS NOT OLD.taken_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a trade record only gains its times');END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trades_inserted_once BEFORE INSERT ON trades WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trades WHERE key_fingerprint = NEW.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = NEW.robot_index) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (IGNORE);END
